name: gift-parser
title: Moodle GIFT quiz parser
prompt:
Implement `parse_gift(text)` in `gift.py` for this subset of Moodle's GIFT quiz format:
- lines whose first non-space characters are `//` are comments and are ignored
- questions are separated by one or more blank lines; a question's lines are joined with one space
- an optional title at the start: `::Title::`
- the question text is everything before the answer block `{...}` (stripped); anything after `}` is ignored
- answer block:
  * `T`, `TRUE`, `F`, `FALSE` (any case) -> true/false question
  * otherwise options start with `=` (correct) or `~` (wrong). If any `~` option exists it is a
    multiple-choice question that needs EXACTLY one `=` option; if all options start with `=` it is a
    short-answer question (all of them are accepted answers)
  * inside an option, an unescaped `#` starts feedback, which is dropped; option texts are stripped
- escapes `\~ \= \# \{ \} \: \\` produce the literal character, in titles, texts and answers
Each question is a dict: `{"title": str or None, "text": str, "type": "tf"|"mc"|"short",
"answers": list, "correct": ...}` where tf -> answers `[]`, correct `True/False`; mc -> answers = all
option texts in order, correct = the `=` option text; short -> answers = accepted answers,
correct = the same list. Raise `ValueError` for a question without an answer block or text, or an
mc question without exactly one `=` option.
